com.ibm.cos.v2.utils.cache

Class NonBlocking

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.ibm.cos.v2.utils.cache.NonBlocking
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    CachedSupplier.PrefetchStrategy, SdkAutoCloseable, AutoCloseable

    public class NonBlocking
extends Object
implements CachedSupplier.PrefetchStrategy
    A CachedSupplier.PrefetchStrategy that will run a single thread in the background to update the value. A call to prefetch on this strategy will never return. Multiple calls to prefetch(Runnable) will still only result in one background task performing the update.
